notes.text: The biblical verse names Zevina. The linked Sotah names Rav Yehudah bar Zevina, who appears again at [12a:13](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.12a.13) and [12a:16](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.12a.16). Hyman lists the biblical name and the later patronymic separately.
